description: Owner or office: one month (or from and to) of the shop's money as a ZIP for a bookkeeper or for QuickBooks Online by hand: a ledger CSV of every invoice, void, payment, refund, fee and payout, QuickBooks Online invoice import files, and QuickBooks Online bank upload files for a clearing account. Use this only when the shop has no agent QuickBooks sync; the sync (sync.changes) is the main way. The same period gives the same file and sha256 every time. You get download_url (60 minutes, 5 downloads; anyone with the link can download, so do not share it) or, with delivery inline, zip_base64 up to 5 MB.

include_imported.description: Add payments imported from the shop's old system (history only). Default false.

month.description: YYYY-MM, like 2026-10. Or send from and to.
